description: Revoke the token this call is made with, so it stops working at once: every later call with it is refused. It only ever revokes the calling token (there is no target to pass), never another token of the account. Already revoked or expired counts as done (ok, already_revoked:true), not as an error. Needs the token's "Allow revoke and unlink" permission, which is off until your user ticks it at /account/tokens/. Requires your Autoview account token.

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: revoke_token
